subject: Re: Zenith Health - audit rights, pen-test window & evidence cadence
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@zenithhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Ken Alvarez <ken.alvarez@zenithhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zenith - security exhibit draft and questions on audit cadence

Hi Michael,

Thanks for sending over the MSA/Order Form earlier. Our legal and security teams reviewed the draft and attached a proposed security exhibit (attached: zenith-security-exhibit-draft-v2.pdf) with a few asks. High-level items: 

- Clarify pen-test access window and whether Redwood will accept a vendor-supplied vulnerability report or require co-ordinated tests on staging.
- Define SOC 2 artifact ownership and minimum evidence retention period (we've proposed 24 months).
- Request for an inspection/sampling cadence: quarterly for year one, then biannual.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Provide a timeboxed pen-test window on a staging environment with ephemeral credentials?
2) Route evidence requests to a single intake owner instead of ad-hoc emailing?
3) Support a 48-hour SLA for evidence turnaround when items are already collected in your SOC2 repository?

We're trying to align the order form timeline with our procurement deadlines (end of Aug). If you prefer, we can jump on a 30-min call this week.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Sr. Security Program Manager, Zenith Health
priya.shah@zenithhealth.com

Attachments: zenith-security-exhibit-draft-v2.pdf (PDF, 210KB); pen-test-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14KB)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zenith - security exhibit draft and questions on audit cadence

Thanks Priya — appreciate the clear list. Looping in Ben (ops) and Laura (legal) to confirm operational feasibility and contract language. Below are proposed positions from Redwood to help speed to signature: 

1) Pen-test window: we can provide a timeboxed staging environment with ephemeral credentials for an agreed 72-hour testing window. We prefer vendor-conducted tests against that staging environment; Redwood will accept the vendor report as primary evidence provided the test scope, methodology, and root cause notes are included. We cannot permit unscheduled testing on production.

2) Evidence intake: we can designate a single evidence intake owner — Redwood Security will assign an evidence mailbox (security-evidence@redwood.com) and a named lead for the engagement. That lead will triage requests and provide a single consolidated drop for artifacts.

3) Evidence SLA: 48 hours is reasonable for items that are already collected in our SOC2 evidence store. For ad-hoc requests (logs, live traces) we will commit to an "operational SLA" depending on the artifact type — propose 5 business days. We can include an appendix that defines the artifact types and expected turnaround.

Other notes on cadence and sampling: we want to avoid continuous quarterly sampling for material that has low variance (e.g., architecture diagrams). Suggest a hybrid cadence: quarterly sampling for configuration and patch evidence in year one, then triage to biannual if no control regressions; SOC2 rolling evidence remains available upon request.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura to propose redline language for the security exhibit and pen-test clause.
- Ben to propose formal staging schedule and the template for ephemeral credentials and NDA for vendor testers.
- Sync call if Zenith procurement still needs the signed docs this month.

Happy to jump on a call tomorrow 10–10:30 PT.

Best,
Michael Grant
Director, Technical Account Management
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment references: zenith-security-exhibit-draft-v2.pdf; pen-test-scope.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zenith - security exhibit draft and questions on audit cadence

Priya / Michael,

Thanks — I reviewed the attached exhibit and drafted a small set of redlines to balance Zenith's needs with Redwood's operational constraints. Summary of the proposed contract language (high level):

- Pen-test: Redwood agrees to provide a dedicated staging window and will accept a vendor-supplied report as evidence where the vendor is accredited and the test is executed against the agreed staging environment. Redwood requires a 14-day notice to schedule the staging window and a signed tester NDA. Redwood disclaims liability for issues found outside the agreed scope or in customer-managed integrations.

- Audit/Inspection: Redwood will provide inspection rights limited to non-production environments with a timeboxed sampling approach. We will provide SOC 2 Type II reports and a named evidence owner; extended forensic access requires a mutual statement of work.

- Evidence retention: Redwood maintains evidence for 18 months by default. If Zenith requires 24 months, we can add a limited retention extension at an additional professional services fee; alternatively, specify exceptions (critical compliance artifacts retained for 24 months).

I'll attach the redline as a PDF in the next message (legal redline). If that approach is acceptable to Zenith, I can prepare clean contract language for the MSA appendix and updated order form terms.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: redline-security-exhibit.pdf (will attach)

On calls / next steps: if Zenith accepts the 14-day notice for pen-test windows and the 18-month default retention with optional 24-month fee, we should be able to finalize before end of August.

Regards,
Laura

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@zenithhealth.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zenith - security exhibit draft and questions on audit cadence

Hi Priya — operational notes from the infra side: 

- Staging windows: we use a standard slotting system. If you provide preferred dates, we will return a confirmed 72-hour window within 7 business days of notice (14-day advanced notice as Laura suggests gives us the best chance to isolate resources).

- Credentials: ephemeral creds will be issued via our Secrets Manager and automatically revoked after the test window. We will require a tester email list and the signed tester NDA before provisioning.

- Evidence handoff: we will use the security-evidence@redwood.com mailbox and a shared Drive folder (read-only) where artifacts will be uploaded. We'll provide a CSV manifest for each request to speed reconciliation.

Priya — if Zenith can accept the 14-day scheduling anchor and the 18-month default evidence retention with an optional paid extension to 24 months, I think we can scope and sign the order form quickly. Otherwise, flag the specific artifacts you must have retained 24 months and we can carve those into the appendix.

If helpful, I can create a short checklist (staging request template, NDA template, manifest format) and share it today.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Systems Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
